about:
The Salt Licking Goat Clothing Company operates from Fairplay, Colorado, a mountain town situated at 10,957 feet above sea level. The business was established in 2009. Public records do not disclose the ownership structure or the names of the founders.

The company sells Colorado-themed gifts, souvenirs, and apparel through its Fairplay storefront. It also offers on-site expert assistance for custom design projects, indicating a capability in custom apparel decoration such as screen printing or embroidery, though the specific processes are not detailed. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not publicly reported.

The primary customer base appears to be tourists visiting the South Park region and local residents seeking region-specific merchandise. The custom design service may also serve businesses, organizations, or events looking for personalized apparel, but no specific industry clients are named in available sources.

The company emphasizes personalized service and a product selection that captures the spirit of the Rockies. No explicit founding mission or stated competitive differentiation beyond local charm and design assistance is provided in the source material.
